title: Houston Heights eBike VIP Private Foodie Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Looking for a fun and delicious way to explore Houston's Heights neighborhood? Look no further than Pedego's Electric Bike food tour, which takes you on a culinary journey through some of the area's best restaurants and bakeries.
Hopdoddy, Dish Society, Postinos, The Bearded Baker, and Homestead are just a few of the stops on this mouth-watering tour. You'll get to taste a variety of dishes, from handcrafted burgers and locally sourced deliciousness to artisanal bread and decadent pastries.
And the best part? You'll be able to explore the neighborhood on a Pedego Electric Bike, which is both eco-friendly and a blast to ride. With a Pedego, you can cover more ground and see more of the city while still enjoying the food tour experience.
So whether you're a foodie looking to discover new flavors or simply want to explore the city in a unique and exciting way, Pedego's food tour in the Heights is not to be missed!
